propositions: Hand-rolled CLI argument parsing loops in claim.py and transition.py must be replaced with argparse while preserving all load-bearing semantics (None-vs-empty-string distinctions, command-specific --force behavior, unknown-token skipping, exit codes).
--force bare form must consume following non-option token in claim but NOT in transition; both must map bare form to '(no reason given)' via _force_note.
--assignee absent must yield None (triggering default_assignee fallback) while explicit --assignee "" must clear the assignee; value-less --assignee must exit 1 with historical error message.

argparse parser must disable help generation (--help served byte-exact from golden help/claim.txt and help/transition.txt by dispatcher, not regenerated), disable abbreviation matching, and raise CommandError(returncode=1) instead of argparse's default exit-2 on errors.

transition._parse_flags must be retained as a thin argparse-backed shim returning the identical 5-tuple (reason, force_reason, close_class, caused_by, ref) for three external direct callers; retired --force-close must be explicitly rejected with exit 1.

Refactored code must respect module-size constraint (≤800 LOC) and complexity ratchet; _parse_flags complexity must drop below its baseline threshold of 17 to drain the stale baseline entry from .github/complexity-baseline.json.
